$comment: Fixed before the first measuring run (2026-11-12). A module (one source file) is a candidate when any signature below fires; candidates are then read and confirmed or rejected in review.json. Changing a signature after a run needs a line in docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md, Method.

library.$comment: Signature 1: a JSX element whose root identifier is imported from one of these packages (prefix match on the module specifier). `frames` are wrappers that draw no data-mapped mark; a module whose only library tags are frames does not fire.

kit.$comment: Signature 1, kit and component-library marks: a JSX element with one of these export names imported from the listed package family. basalt-ui means `basalt-ui` and every `basalt-ui/*` subpath.

svg.$comment: Signature 2: an intrinsic <svg> element whose subtree contains a `.map`/`.flatMap`/`Array.from` callback, or a descendant (not the <svg> itself) with a geometry attribute bound to a non-literal expression. Also an imperative SVG (`createElementNS` call).

canvas.$comment: Signature 2, canvas: an intrinsic <canvas> element, or a `getContext` call.

cells.$comment: Signature 3: a JSX element (intrinsic or component) whose `style` object has one of `styleKeys` (or a `--custom-property` key), or which has one of `sizeProps`, bound to a non-literal expression, and either (a) sits inside a `.map`/`.flatMap`/`Array.from` callback, or (b) the value is a template literal or string concatenation that contains `%`.
